---
title: "Resources"
order: 94
---

Three places to check this module's reasoning yourself, or go deeper on the definitions it
leans on. All three were checked and loading (via `curl`) at the time this page was written.

- **[45 CFR 160.103, eCFR](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-45/subtitle-A/subchapter-C/part-160/subpart-A/section-160.103)**
  — the current, official text of the section this entire module is built on: covered entity,
  health care provider, business associate, protected health information, and individually
  identifiable health information, all in one place. This is the primary source `sources/cfr/45-160.103.md`
  was excerpted from — read the full section if you want the definitions this module didn't need
  (health plan, health care clearinghouse, and the health-plan sub-definitions among them).

- **[45 CFR 160.102, eCFR](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-45/subtitle-A/subchapter-C/part-160/subpart-A/section-160.102)**
  — the applicability section sitting right next to 160.103. It states which parts of the HIPAA
  Administrative Simplification regulations apply "to the following entities," i.e., it's the
  provision that actually puts weight behind the "covered entity" label once a determination
  like this module's is made. Worth reading once alongside 160.103, not quoted here.

- **[45 CFR 160.103, Cornell Legal Information Institute](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/45/160.103)**
  — a secondary, independently maintained mirror of the same section, useful for a fast
  cross-check or a plain-text copy to search, the same way this curriculum has used Cornell's
  mirrors for CFR sections since `csv-and-becs`.
